title: Coronary angiography: vessel segments and narrowings marked by cardiologists
description: Invasive coronary angiograms (single contrast-filled frames, 512 x 512 px) from the ARCADE dataset, one case per image, each with the SYNTAX vessel segments outlined by interventional cardiologists and the narrowings of 50% or more marked as regions (one initial annotator, cross-validated by two senior doctors). Right and left coronary systems in many projections. No pixel size or projection angle is distributed.

sources.name: ARCADE: x-ray angiography images with SYNTAX vessel-segment and stenosis annotations (Research Institute of Cardiology and Internal Diseases, Almaty)
sources.citation: Popov M, Amanturdieva A, Zhaksylyk N, Alkanov A, Saniyazbekov A, Aimyshev T, Ismailov E, Bulegenov A, Kuzhukeyev A, Kulanbayeva A, Kalzhanov A, Temirgaliyev N, Kuzhukeyeva A, Zhakenov A, Ruziyev G, Moldagaliyev D, Tleulesov B, Kussainov I, Moldagulova A, Zhumabayev A. Dataset for Automatic Region-based Coronary Artery Disease Diagnostics Using X-Ray Angiography Images. Scientific Data 11, 20 (2024). doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02871-z. Data: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.10390295.
sources.accessNote: arcade.zip (451,573,813 bytes) downloaded without login or agreement from the open Zenodo record 10390295 (https://zenodo.org/api/records/10390295/files/arcade.zip/content); MD5 c5b1973ade06f7dff210f878161e1a76 checked against the record. Images and COCO annotations of the `syntax` and `stenosis` folders read as distributed.

referenceTargets.label: Posterior descending artery (from the right coronary artery) (segment 4)

provenanceDetail.method: Vessel segment outlined as a polygon in CVAT by interventional cardiologists following the SYNTAX score segment definitions (segments 1-16c); each image had one initial annotator and was cross-validated by two senior doctors, with the consensus as the final label (Popov et al. 2024). The polygon is as distributed, converted from pixel-corner to pixel-centre coordinates (-0.5 px) into image_px [col, row].
provenanceDetail.note: SYNTAX segment 4. The paper reports a mean Dice agreement between annotators of 0.73-0.90, with most disagreement at segment borders and on small vessels.

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the SYNTAX segments the experts outlined are referenced; the paper notes the masks cover roughly 60-80% of the visible vessels, so a visible branch without an outline is not an error.

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only narrowings of 50% or more that the experts marked are referenced. Milder narrowings, occlusions beyond the region, small branches and the haemodynamic significance are not; a real narrowing without a region here is not an error.
